audit.title: Keep Club progress plateau audit

in: exam-date interval ceiling and scheduling math
sync behavior relevant to the supplied state
out: unrelated media, import, and offline behavior
unrelated generic sync and practice-session defects

audit.toolingDeviation: The Claude Code Workflow runner was unavailable. Independent read-only collaboration agents were used for isolated finder, verifier, and completeness-critic waves.
audit.secretHandling: The supplied sync key was used only for a read-only lookup and is omitted from all persisted audit artifacts.

syncScope.qualification: The supplied identity contains Competent Crew state only; unsupplied device-local state was not audited.

verdicts.claim: For review cards, exam mode stores its shortened next-review interval in the same field used for mastery; setting an exam no more than 102 days away or giving a correct scheduled answer can demote solid progress, and clearing or postponing the exam does not restore the former interval.

failureScenario.action: Set examDate to 2026-09-19, then clear it; separately grade Good and Easy under that exam.

verification.narrowing: Applies to review records and non-practice scheduled grades where the future exam is 102 or fewer calendar days away.

verdicts.killList: The clamp itself is intentional, but no RULING approves mastery demotion or non-restoration.

verdicts.claim: With only the supplied export loaded, the exam date unchanged, and reviews graded Hard, Good, or Easy through 2026-09-19, no card can reach the 21-day solid threshold; every fully seen section remains 50% and solid-derived course achievements remain locked.

verification.boundary: The cap is below 21 from 102 days before the exam through exam day and returns to 400 on the day after the exam. Again can lower a row below 50%.

verdicts.killList: The clamp and threshold are separately intentional; their unreachable interaction is not settled.

verdicts.claim: At the export timestamp, Home labels a half-weighted familiarity score as known well in all 14 sections while exact Progress reports zero solid and zero known-well cards.

failureScenario.progress: 0 solid globally and 0 known well in every expanded section

verification.narrowing: When cards become pending, Home replaces the literal percentage sentence with card count metadata, but the 50% meter remains.

verdicts.killList: No RULING approves half-credit young cards or the known-well label.

verdicts.claim: When pct is positive and a section has pending or unseen cards, Home displays a meter without exposing an equivalent progress value to assistive technology.

failureScenario.buttonAccessibleName: 01 Sea terms, parts of the boat, rigging and sails. 1 to review. 34 cards. Study this section.

verification.mainLoopHandRepro: CONFIRMED with a distinct mature/young/learning/fresh mix
verification.counterexample: Fully scheduled rows with no pending/fresh cards include the percentage in the button name; zero-percent rows render no meter.

verdicts.claim: Progress can display a kept-achievement threshold as reached while the achievement remains locked because the display rounds and the evaluator compares the raw percentage.

failureScenario.course: Valid schema-v2 imported course with one titled group and 101 cards

verification.independentVerifier: CONFIRMED using schema validation and the real evaluator
verification.narrowing: Requires a titled group, no prior unlock, and a raw value that rounds up to but remains below the threshold.

verdicts.claim: Lost, stale, capped, malformed, or deck-mismatched review records caused the supplied 50% plateau.

counterChecks: answers 903 equals sum of card repetitions
answers 903 equals sum of daily history

verification.browserRestore: All 200 records retained; 0 page and console errors
verification.replacementExplanation: All intact records are young and therefore contribute exactly 0.5 to Home.

byDesign.decision: Keep an exam-date interval clamp so cramming mode changes scheduling.
Define solid/mature as a review interval of at least 21 days.

coverageGap: No existing test combines a future exam ceiling below 21 days, the exact solid threshold, Home's half-credit percentage, and the destructive interval rewrite/clear path.

mustFixesApplied: Narrowed C-01 from every stored interval to every larger review-card interval.
shouldFixesApplied: Removed draft from the published title.
Reframed the final open ruling as a repair-validation scope decision.

repair.scope: Progress scheduling, proof, presentation, accessibility, ingestion, backup, sync convergence, revealed-plan reload safety, and the progress-sync rollout fence only.

behavior.homeProgress: mature/total, using the same >=21-day proven interval as Progress and achievements; young cards receive no synthetic half credit
behavior.examScheduling: effectiveDue projects the active exam cap from the canonical answer schedule without rewriting ordinary ivl/due or pv
behavior.correctGrades: Good and Easy retain same-roll uncapped schedule/proof; Hard stores its exact displayed actual gap while retaining stronger proof
behavior.failureGrade: Again remains evidence of forgetting and retains 40 percent of prior proof
behavior.revealedPlans: The four already-rolled plans survive same-record/same-setting reload and midnight; malformed, legacy, record-stale, or settings-stale bundles resume unrevealed.
behavior.ingress: pv, sr, lp, ivl, and answer-scoped exam commitments are bounded and canonicalized across cold load, restore, durable writes, and sync.
behavior.sync: Schedule/proof merges converge by lapse epoch and schedule revision; v2 RPCs fence legacy writers under locked GET/adopt-before-CAS ordering.

repair.historicalLimitation: The larger uncapped intervals overwritten by the old scheduler were never recorded and cannot be reconstructed exactly. The supplied legacy 2-7 day intervals remain the initial surviving proof; future correct answers can now grow proof beyond 21 days while exam due dates remain capped.

finalAdversarialReview.toolingDeviation: Claude Workflow was unavailable; isolated read-only collaboration agents preserved finder/verifier separation against the pinned SHA.

localVerification.localDatabase: Fresh reset through all migrations; catalog/grant fingerprints, REST boundary, locked read/adoption/conflict races, legacy fail-closed behavior, and v2 CAS passed.

productionVerification.migrationOrder: All three progress migrations applied before the web publish.
productionVerification.readiness: progress sync v2 RPCs and locked conflict fences are ready
productionVerification.syncLifecycle: Legacy seed, v2 adoption on stale conflict, legacy GET invisibility, legacy PUT SQLSTATE 55000, v2 proof/provenance write, and stale v2 CAS all passed.
